verified: Sand.ai announced on November 25 that it intends to open-source the full weights of MAGI-2, described as a 480B-parameter mixture-of-experts audio-video model activating about 28B parameters per inference, with a 1080P API list price of ¥0.5 per second and existing adaptations for Hygon and Moore Threads chips, GeekPark reported.
unconfirmed: that MAGI-2 actually tops Artificial Analysis's image-to-video-with-audio ranking and beats Seedance 2.5 — that comparison, the "under one tenth" cost gap (which depends on Seedance 2.5's own unstated list price), the liblib blind-test result, and the 30-second/20-asset capabilities all rest on Sand.ai's account; the weights have not been published, and no release date, license or independent benchmark has been provided.

verified: 据极客公园报道，Sand.ai 于 11 月 25 日宣布计划尽快开源 MAGI-2 全量权重；该模型为 480B 总参数 MoE 架构、单次推理激活约 28B，官方 API 刊例价为 1080P 每秒 0.5 元。
unconfirmed: 权重何时发布、采用何种许可证、“全量”具体涵盖哪些组件均未说明；“AA 榜单第一”出自公司提供的截图与 liblib 盲测对比，并非独立复核结果；0.5 元/秒的计费细则、并发配额，以及本地私有化部署后的真实成本，也都没有第三方验证。

titles.en: Sand.ai plans to open-source 480B MAGI-2 video model with ¥0.5/s API pricing
titles.zh: Sand.ai 计划开源 480B 参数 MAGI-2，API 定价 0.5 元/秒
